The SAME MemoryError also aborted the background ingest-finalize path twice in that window via data_manager.py:3361 _refresh_ingest_aggregates -> ... -> research.py:242. Root cause read directly by the evaluator at apps/backend/app/engine/research.py:207-217: the ForwardReturn scan is column-projected and yield_per-bounded, but its results are accumulated into ret_by_run_symbol, an unbounded in-RAM dict keyed by every (run_id, symbol) pair in the table - an unbounded whole-table materialization in substance, on a request path, on the deep basis. Scored MINOR rather than critical on stated grounds, following the iter-26 precedent for a live 500 on a user-facing endpoint: the service was never taken down (GET /api/health answered 200 between the two failures and GET /api/backtest?as_of=2015-09-09 answered 200 immediately after), zero product code here is this iteration's, the host was simultaneously running this pipeline's own 200-test pytest against a ulimit -v cap, and every unblock path is agent-tractable.
